theater: 睦州幫源洞、歙州與杭州

battle.name: 方臘起義
battle.theater: 睦州幫源洞、歙州與杭州
battle.brief: 宣和二年十月，睦州幫源洞的方臘聚眾起事，數月之間攻取歙、睦、杭等州縣，江南震動。宋廷先命童貫率京師禁軍南下，繼以韓世忠、劉延慶、王淵分道進剿，張叔夜直取杭州；明年四月官軍攻破幫源洞，擒方臘送杭州處死。同期歐洲的圍城靠配重投石車決定城牆存亡，而宋軍攻城仍以雲梯、撞木與弩機為主。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 方臘起義是一場發生在北宋宣和年間的江南內亂，交戰一方是宋廷及其調集的官軍、團練與鄉兵，另一方是起於睦州幫源洞的方臘義軍。義軍並非國家對國家的戰爭，而是以摩尼教為紐帶、以幫源洞為根據地、以浙西鄉民與流亡為主體的起事隊伍，起事後數月之內連取歙、睦、杭、處等州縣，東南形勢為之一空。宋廷方面，決策在宣和殿上由徽宗與宰相王黼、蔡京一級作出；宣和三年正月詔命宦官童貫為宣撫使、譙家為宣撫副使，率京師禁軍及秦晉蕃漢兵南下討伐。兵到江南後並無統一指揮：劉延慶、王淵領前軍分道進剿，折彥質率鄴郡兵、劉光世率淮西兵、姚仲率西北兵各由本路進兵，張叔夜率御營兵由衢州一路疾進，韓世忠以行軍統制身份為先鋒。地方上只有團練與保甲可以依靠，禁軍將校各懷異心，糧餉須由江淮水路接濟。義軍方面，據宋廷奏報常寫成數十萬之眾，實際編制以鄉民步卒為主，缺馬缺甲，能夠投入野戰的骨幹兵力遠少於此數。宣和三年十月義軍平定之後，宋廷隨即詔罷花石綱與方臘軍，江南才重新歸入朝廷控制。
countriesEn: The Fang La rising was a civil disturbance in the south of the Yangtze during the Xuanhe reign of the Northern Song. One side was the Song court with the imperial army it mustered, the local militia corps and the village militia; the other was the rebel host that rose in Bangyuan Cave in Muzhou. The rebels were not a state fighting a state but a movement held together by Manichaeism, based on the caves of Bangyuan and made up mainly of the peasants and vagrants of western Zhe. Within a few months they took Shzhou, Muzhou, Hangzhou and Zhuozhou in turn, and the southeast lay momentarily open. On the Song side the decisions were taken in the Xuanhe hall by Emperor Huizong with the chancellors Wang Fu and Cai Jing; in the first month of Xuanhe 3 an edict named the eunuch Tong Guan as xuanfu commissioner and Qiao Jia as his deputy, sending the capital garrison and the Shaanxi, Shanxi and mixed tribal troops of the north down the river to fight. Once in Jiangnan there was no single command: Liu Yanqing and Wang Yuan led the vanguard along separate roads, Zhe Yaoqi brought up the Ye command, Liu Guangshi the Huaiwest command and Yao Zhong the northwest command, while Zhang Shuye led the imperial camp troops down from Quzhou and Han Shizhong served as advance guard with the title of marching commander. Locally only the militia and the baojia could be relied upon; the garrison officers each pursued his own game, and grain had to come up the waterways from the Huai and the Yangtze. On the rebel side the numbers in the Song memorials are habitually written up to several hundred thousand, but the real order of battle was made of village footmen short of horses and armour, and the fighting core was far smaller than that figure. After the rising was put down in the tenth month of Xuanhe 3 the court abolished the flowery-stone tribute and the Fang La levy, and Jiangnan came back under government control.
people: 核心人物是方臘。他本是睦州幫源洞一帶的抬木工人，常隨鄉人押送木材到州城，途中遇遊方僧人淨因，聽其講摩尼教「明王出世」之說，自此以吃菜事為戒，宣傳末世劫變，漸為鄉民所信。起事之後方臘自居明王，妻邵氏亦參與其事，弟方七與數名渠帥分據州縣，各部名號互異，彼此並無嚴密編制。宋廷一方的關鍵人物則在將帥：宣撫使童貫以京師禁軍為主力南下，出兵之初姿態極盛，屢敗之後士氣崩解，敗走杭州時夜宿城隍廟，被隨軍士兵戲稱為城隍。張叔夜最見功，他自衢州兼程而進，以夜襲奪回杭州，破城之後又窮追至幫源洞，是擒獲方臘的關鍵人物。韓世忠守杭州城時所部兵數遠少於義軍，卻藉旗幟蔽野、虛張聲勢與夜遣死士出城縱火穩住城防，隨後在追擊中屢次先登。劉延慶、王淵分任統制，率前軍掃蕩歙、睦一線，是中期攻勢的主力。折彥質、劉光世、姚仲各率本路兵馬，雖然遲滯，卻維持住後方與糧道。岳飛於此役中自基層領兵奉調歸入官軍序列，於徽州一線破敵而升為步軍副統制，隨後隨張叔夜攻杭州，這是他早年目錄中最早的一場大戰。
peopleEn: The central figure is Fang La himself. He was by origin a timber-carrier from the Bangyuan Cave district of Muzhou, used to escort wood down to the prefectural city with the villagers, and on one of those journeys met a travelling monk, Jing Yin, who spoke to him of the Manichaean doctrine of the coming King of Light. From then on he kept the vegetarian prohibition of the faith, preached the end of the age, and was gradually believed in by the country people. Once the rising began Fang La set himself up as the King of Light; his wife Shao took part in the business, and his younger brother Fang Qi and a number of rebel commanders held different prefectures under different names, with no strict organisation binding them together. On the Song side the decisive figures were the generals. Xuanfu commissioner Tong Guan led the campaign with the capital garrison as his main body; at first his manner was enormously confident, and after repeated defeats the morale of his troops broke down, and when he fled to Hangzhou he spent a night in the city god temple, where the soldiers mockingly called him the city god himself. Zhang Shuye showed the most clearly: he advanced at forced march from Quzhou, retook Hangzhou by a night attack, and after the city fell pursued the rebels all the way to Bangyuan Cave, and it was he who cornered Fang La. Han Shizhong, with far fewer men than the rebels besieging Hangzhou, steadied the defence by spreading banners across the fields to make the enemy believe the city was held in strength, and by sending sallied men out by night to fire the enemy camp; he led repeatedly in the pursuit afterwards. Liu Yanqing and Wang Yuan, both with the rank of commander, led the vanguard in the clearing of the Shezhou and Muzhou lines and formed the main weight of the offensive in its middle stage. Zhe Yaoqi, Liu Guangshi and Yao Zhong each brought the troops of their own region; slow and clumsy as they were, they kept the rear and the supply line in being. Yue Fei, then a low-ranking officer, was mustered into the government force during this campaign, broke the enemy on the Huizhou front and was raised to deputy commander of the infantry, afterwards following Zhang Shuye in the assault on Hangzhou; it is the first great battle recorded in his early career.
kits: 卡面這件配重投石車，設計年份定在一一〇〇年，正是歐洲與地中海世界把配重機理用成熟的時期。配重投石車以長臂末端的配重箱產生持續力矩，把石彈拋過城牆，射程與拋射初速都遠勝人力拉臂的拋石機，因此被視為十二世紀圍城工程的分水嶺；其發源地究竟在東亞還是伊斯蘭世界，又如何隨十字軍東征與商路西傳，學界至今仍有爭議。中國方面的技術路線並不同步：宋代城防的主要拋射火力是床子弩與神臂弓這類弩機，《武經總要》已載火藥箭與火球一類早期火器，但把配重原理用於砲車的「回回砲」要到十三世紀蒙古入主中原之後才在中原軍隊中出現。因此在方臘之亂的戰場上，真正決定攻防的並不是配重砲，而是撞木、雲梯、望樓、火箭與水攻。義軍攻歙、杭諸城靠的是內應、夜襲與臨時架設的撞槌，官軍攻城則以雲梯配壕壘圍城周而後徐徐填塞。另一端的守城手段是江面：方臘義軍沿錢塘江與太湖的水網分合遊擊，舟船既是機動工具也是糧道，官軍則由江寧、潤州一線水運兵糧，前後數月都靠這條線維持。弓弩仍是野戰骨幹，鎗、刀、牌與漁獵所得的叉、鏃在山區近戰中被大量使用。
kitsEn: The piece on the card, the counterweight trebuchet, is dated to the year 1100, which is exactly the period when Europe and the Mediterranean world were making the counterweight principle work. A trebuchet produces a continuous moment at the end of a long arm by means of a counterweight box, hurling its stone over the wall; both range and initial velocity are far beyond those of a traction engine worked by manpower, and for that reason it is treated as the dividing line in siegecraft of the twelfth century. Whether the design originated in East Asia or in the Islamic world, and how it reached Europe along the crusading and trading roads, is still argued over by scholars. The Chinese line of development did not move in step: the principal projectile power in Song defences was the bed crossbow and the powerful arm bow and similar crossbow mechanisms, and the Wujing Zongyao already records gunpowder arrows and fire balls of the earliest sort, yet the counterweight principle applied to siege engines, the hui hui pao, does not appear in Chinese armies until the Mongol conquest of the thirteenth century. The machine that actually decided the assault and defence in the fighting of Fang La was therefore not the counterweight engine but the ram, the scaling ladder, the watch tower, fire arrows and water attack. The rebels took the walled cities of Shezhou and Hangzhou by means of insiders, night assaults and rams hastily put together, while the government troops ringed the walls with scaling ladders and trenches and then filled the ditch in gradually. The other end of the problem was the river: Fang La's host moved in divided and joined columns along the network of the Qiantang and the Taihu, where the boats were both their means of movement and their supply line, while the Song troops moved men and grain by water from Jiangning and Runzhou, and for months on end everything hung on that single route. The bow and crossbow remained the backbone of the field battle, and spears, swords, shields and the forks and barbed points taken from fishing and hunting were used in quantity in close fighting in the hills.
tactics: 義軍的戰法以遊擊為主，避免與官軍主力正面撞擊。起事初期以幫源洞的山林為依託，招募鄉民、改造農具為兵器，選夜雨、大霧或嵐氣之時下山，攻擊守備空虛的鄉鎮與縣城，得手即撤，順勢奪取糧秣與器械。義軍也曾主動圍攻州府，但多靠內應、夜間攀城與火攻破門，並以水軍在太湖、錢塘江一帶切斷官軍的水路。官軍初期的處置則是分路平推：劉延慶與王淵以禁軍精銳掃蕩歙、睦諸縣，折彥質、姚仲所部由西北方向壓上，劉光世沿淮西路進，結果是各路互不支援、糧道拉長，士卒疲於奔命，前鋒一旦被義軍夜襲便容易崩潰。張叔夜所部則取完全不同辦法：他不待大軍集齊，自衢州日夜兼程，抵杭州城下即擇夜渡河，先以輕騎焚燒城外義軍營壘，再驟然入城，義軍焚城而走。韓世忠守城時，命令把城上旗幟盡量張滿以亂敵視聽，又在城北門外挖掘暗道，於夜半分批遣死士出城縱火，義軍以為城內已有大軍接應，遂解圍。收官一役，官軍進逼幫源洞，山路狹窄難容大軍，便分隊搜索、以火焚林，逼義軍放棄藏身之處。
tacticsEn: The method of the rebels was that of the raider: they avoided meeting the main body of the government army head on. At the outset they relied on the woods and ravines of Bangyuan, drew in the country people and converted farm tools into weapons, and came down off the hills on nights of rain, fog or mountain haze to strike towns and county seats whose garrisons were empty; on success they withdrew at once, carrying off grain and matériel as they went. They did besiege prefectural cities as well, but usually by means of insiders, ladders in the dark and fire at the gates, and they used their boats on the Taihu and the Qiantang to cut the government's waterborne supply. The government's first way of handling the rising was to push forward in separate columns: Liu Yanqing and Wang Yuan swept the counties of Shezhou and Muzhou with the best of the garrison, the troops of Zhe Yaoqi and Yao Zhong pressed down from the north-west and Liu Guangshi came along the Huaiwest road. The result was that the columns supported none of each other and the supply lines grew longer, the soldiers were worn out by constant marching, and an advance guard caught in a night attack by the rebels would easily break. Zhang Shuye's troops did the opposite: without waiting for the main army to assemble, he marched day and night out of Quzhou, and on reaching the walls of Hangzhou chose the night to cross the river, burning the rebel camp outside the city with light horse first and then bursting into the town, whereupon the rebels fired the city and ran. When Han Shizhong held the city he ordered every banner on the walls to be spread so as to confuse the enemy's view, and had a covered way dug outside the northern gate, and at dead of night sent groups of picked men out to set fires; the rebels, believing a great host had come in from within, lifted the siege. In the closing operation the government troops closed on Bangyuan, where the mountain path was too narrow for a great army, and so they searched in small parties and fired the brush, forcing the rebels out of their hiding places.
data: 可核的數字有限，但幾個節點可以確定。起事時間為宣和二年十月，即公曆一一二〇年十一月；至宣和三年四月官軍攻入幫源洞擒獲方臘，前後不足一年，其中大規模戰鬥集中在最初三個月。地理上，義軍盤據的幫源洞在睦州西南今淳安一帶山地，距杭州依當時山路約二百餘里；義軍一度控制的州縣，記載稱在六州四十餘縣，顯係誇大，較可靠的估計是實際控制範圍隨戰況消長，多在三四縣至十餘縣之間。兵員方面，宋廷奏報常稱義軍有數十萬乃至百餘萬，官軍出兵名額則記為十餘萬至十五萬，兩者都應視為宣示性的數字；官軍真正投入作戰的兵力分佈在劉延慶、王淵、張叔夜等數支部隊，每部大致在數千至數萬之譜，張叔夜一路以精兵數千先行。損失方面，史料記載官軍在歙、睦、杭一線折損甚眾，劉延慶部曾整建制覆沒，延慶本人於班師途中身亡；被擄的將校曾送至杭州示眾。糧運數量無從核算，但江淮漕運被義軍切斷數月，是雙方都知道無法長久承受的瓶頸。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, but several fixed points can be stated. The rising began in the tenth month of Xuanhe 2, that is November 1120 of the Gregorian calendar, and it was over by the fourth month of Xuanhe 3, when the government troops entered Bangyuan Cave and took Fang La; the whole business took less than a year, with the large fighting concentrated in the first three months. Geographically, Bangyuan Cave, where the rebels held, lay in the hills southwest of Muzhou, in what is now Chun'an; by the mountain roads of the time it was about two hundred li from Hangzhou. The prefectures and counties the rebels are said to have controlled are given as six prefectures and more than forty counties, which is plainly exaggerated; the better estimate is that the area actually held varied with the fortunes of the war, mostly between three or four counties and a dozen or so. As for numbers of men, Song memorials habitually credit the rebels with several hundred thousand or even over a million, and the nominal size of the government force is written down as between a hundred thousand and a hundred and fifty thousand; both figures are better read as declarations than counts. The troops really committed to battle were distributed among several bodies under Liu Yanqing, Wang Yuan and Zhang Shuye, each ranging from a few thousand to several tens of thousands, while Zhang Shuye came on ahead with several thousand picked men. As to losses, the records state that the government troops suffered heavily on the Shezhou, Muzhou and Hangzhou lines, that Liu Yanqing's command was destroyed entire at one point, and that Yanqing himself died on the march home; captured officers were sent to Hangzhou and paraded before the enemy. The tonnage of grain cannot be reconstructed, but the fact that the grain traffic between the Huai and the Yangtze was cut for a number of months is a constraint both sides knew they could not bear for long.
cause: 起義的成因有政治、經濟與宗教三層。政治上，宣和年間朝廷對江南的索取急於北方戰事，兩浙官府以苛急的賦役、括徵與加派轉嫁民間，州縣吏治嚴酷，民間對朝廷的信任已近於零。經濟上，蔡京推行花石綱，從浙東、江南各州強取奇花異石以供汴京園苑，舟船徵發動輒以萬計，既擾亂漕運，也傷損生業；同時江浙連年水旱，米價騰貴，饑民流散，給了起事以兵源。宗教上，摩尼教自唐代以來在民間祕密傳播，宋廷查禁不嚴，淨因等僧人往來於浙西鄉里，以「明王出世」「即時享太平」相號召，把末世的恐懼與救贖的期望編織成群眾性的信仰，這正是方臘得以短時間內聚起數萬人的關鍵技術條件。外部環境同樣重要：宋廷正傾力對付遼國與新立的西夏，北方精銳大部調往前線，江南只剩團練與保甲，防守空虛，義軍得以在山區迅速擴張。
causeEn: The causes of the rising run in three layers, political, economic and religious. Politically, the court's demands on the south of the Yangtze were sharpened by the wars in the north, and the provincial governments of the two Zhe transferred the burden onto the people through harsh levies, surcharges and forced collections; the administration of the counties was severe, and trust in the court among the people had come close to zero. Economically, Cai Jing's flowery-stone tribute took rare flowers and strange stones by force from the prefectures of eastern Zhe and Jiangnan to fill the gardens of Bianjing, mustering boats by the ten thousand and disturbing both the grain traffic and the livelihood of the districts; at the same time floods and drought had visited the two Zhe in succession, the price of rice rose steeply, and famine drove people from their homes, which gave the rising its manpower. Religiously, Manichaeism had been spreading secretly among the people since the Tang, and the court's suppression was not severe; monks such as Jing Yin moved about the villages of western Zhe preaching the coming of the King of Light and the enjoyment of peace in this world, weaving the fear of the last days and the hope of redemption into a popular faith, and that was the crucial technical condition which allowed Fang La to gather tens of thousands in a short time. The external environment mattered as much: the court was straining against the Liao and the newly risen Western Xia, most of the northern trained troops had been drawn to the front, and in Jiangnan only the militia and the baojia remained, so that the defence was hollow and the rebels could spread quickly in the hills.
impact: 方臘之亂留下的第一個後果是制度性的。江南之亂證明禁軍統制系統無法在缺乏訓練與統一指揮的條件下投入戰役；宣和三年蔡京罷相、童貫兵權被削，朝廷此後把倚重轉向募兵與更嚴格的將領統制，這條路線在南渡之後被推到極致。第二是財政與漕運：平亂之後詔罷花石綱與方臘軍，江南的物資輸送與民力獲得喘息，但同時也說明任何取之於江南的制度若不節制，都會成為動亂的直接導火索。第三是戰略層面的教訓，此役之後建都臨安已成定局，糧道安全從此是南宋頭號國策，兩淮與江防的意義遠高於北方。第四是歷史記憶：這場起事在民間被記為方臘之亂，隨着小說與說書流入《水滸傳》與《說岳全傳》，把方臘改寫為梁山好漢的背景，把岳飛的功業起點挪到江東，從此在戲曲與民間故事中與岳飛綁在一起。第五是對北方戰局的作用，一一二〇至一一二一年被耗掉的江南兵力和西線注意力，使朝廷得以傾力對遼並在一二二二年聯金滅遼，而金人南下時南宋已無可用之兵，一一二七年汴京陷落時的崩潰，部分原因可回溯至此役留下的空虛。
impactEn: The first consequence of the Fang La rising was institutional. The trouble in Jiangnan demonstrated that the garrison command system could not be thrown into a war without training and single command; in Xuanhe 3 Cai Jing was dismissed from the chancellorship and Tong Guan's authority over troops was stripped away, and from then on the court leaned on recruited soldiers and on a tighter control of commanders, a line that was carried to its extreme after the move south of the Yangtze. The second was financial and logistic: after the rising was suppressed, the edict abolished the flowery-stone tribute and the Fang La levy, and the transport of goods and the strength of the people of Jiangnan were given a respite, though it equally showed that any system drawing on Jiangnan, if not restrained, becomes the direct fuse of disorder. The third was a lesson in strategy: after this war the move of the capital to Lin'an was settled, and the security of the grain route became the first policy of the Southern Song, with the Huai and the river defences meaning far more than the north. The fourth was historical memory: the rising was remembered among the people as the Fang La rebellion and, carried by novel and storytelling, flowed into the Water Margin and the Tale of Yue Fei, which rewrote Fang La as the background of the Liangshan heroes and moved the beginning of Yue Fei's career to the east of the river, binding the two together in the drama and the popular story from then on. The fifth was its effect on the war in the north: the Jiangnan troops and the western attention consumed in 1120 and 1121 allowed the court to throw its whole weight against the Liao and to destroy it with the Jin in 1122, and by the time the Jin came south the Song had no troops left to meet them; the collapse when Bianjing fell in 1127 can in part be traced to the hollow left by this rising.
result: 宣和三年正月，張叔夜所部自衢州疾進，夜渡錢塘江，奪回杭州，方臘焚城而出，退回幫源洞，官軍隨即合圍那處山峽。四月，官軍分道搜山、以火焚林，方臘與其妻邵氏及部眾被擒，押送杭州處死，隨行渠帥多被斬於都市。張叔夜因此擢領樞密，韓世忠、劉延慶諸將各論功行賞，朝廷同時大赦天下，詔免因追捕方臘而興起的諸項科斂，並於同年十月正式罷除花石綱與方臘軍，把隨之而來的額外稅收一併取消。殘餘義軍失去首領與根據地後散入浙西、皖南山中，零星抵抗延續數年才完全平定。結果是江南重回朝廷控制，府庫與漕運得以恢復，宋廷也贏得了對付遼國的時間；但代價同樣清楚：將校折損、府庫空虛、地方武備盡耗，南方與京師都元氣大傷。而在靖康之難前五年才剛平定內亂的朝廷，其後很快就要面對北方政權的南下。裝備史的結論是，這場戰爭中真正成熟的攻城技術仍屬雲梯、撞木與弩砲系統，配重投石車所代表的機械化圍城，要到配重砲隨蒙元軍進入中原之後，才在這片土地上有大規模實戰。
resultEn: In the first month of Xuanhe 3 Zhang Shuye's troops pressed forward from Quzhou, crossed the Qiantang by night and retook Hangzhou; Fang La fired the city and got out, falling back on Bangyuan, where the government troops closed in on the gorge. In the fourth month the troops searched the hills in several parties and fired the brush, and Fang La, his wife Shao and those with him were taken and sent to Hangzhou for execution, while the rebel commanders who had come with him were beheaded in the streets. Zhang Shuye was raised in consequence to the head of the military affairs office, Han Shizhong and Liu Yanqing and the other generals were each rewarded for their service, and at the same time the court granted a general amnesty, cancelled the extraordinary levies raised in the pursuit of Fang La, and in the tenth month of the same year formally abolished the flowery-stone tribute and the Fang La levy, along with the extra revenue that had come with them. The remnant rebels, deprived of their leader and their base, scattered into the hills of western Zhe and southern Wan, and their scattered resistance ran on for several years before it was completely put down. The result was that Jiangnan returned to the court's control, the treasuries and the grain traffic recovered, and the court won the time it needed to deal with the Liao; but the cost was equally clear: officers and men were lost, the treasuries were emptied, the local means of defence were used up, and both the south and the capital were badly shaken. The court that had only just settled an internal rising five years before the Disaster of Jingkang soon had to face a northern power moving south. As for the history of equipment, the conclusion is that the siege techniques that were really mature in this war still belonged to the system of scaling ladders, rams and crossbow engines; the mechanised siege that the counterweight trebuchet stands for was not to have large-scale trials on this soil until the counterweight engine entered the Central Plains with the Mongol armies.
